description: Verifies the Barnes-Hut octree on a deterministic Gaussian cloud of 300 softened particles: the tree contains more nodes than particles, the quadrupole-corrected accelerations of twenty particles agree with direct summation within 5 percent of the acceleration magnitude, and ten leapfrog steps keep every particle finite.

checks.label: the octree holds more nodes than particles
every sampled particle has a non-negligible direct acceleration
the tree acceleration agrees with direct summation within 5 percent of the magnitude
every position and velocity stays finite after ten leapfrog steps
